title: К + dative: By evening, by five

blocks.text: К + Dative denotes the time by which an event takes place.

items.text: The preposition К + Dat. denotes the time by which an event takes place. (It answers the question „By what time?“) Он вернётся к двум часам. Приготовьте доклад к понедельнику.

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 77. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.
